command:
if test ! -e /lib/firmware/config.txt &&
    test ! -e /lib/firmware/rtctrl-pm0.txt
then
    echo TEST_PM_CONFIGURATION_RELEASED
else
    echo TEST_PM_CONFIGURATION_REMAINS
fi

if test ! -e /tmp/wpa.conf &&
    test ! -e /sys/class/net/wlan0 &&
    test -z "$(grep '^bcmdhd ' /proc/modules || true)" &&
    test -z "$(ps | grep -E '[w]pa_supplicant|[n]etwork-helper' || true)"
then
    echo NETWORK_RESOURCES_RELEASED
else
    echo NETWORK_RESOURCES_STILL_PRESENT
fi

if grep -vE '^[^ ]+ [^ ]+ (rootfs|devtmpfs|proc|sysfs|tmpfs) ' /proc/mounts
then
    echo UNEXPECTED_FILESYSTEM_PRESENT
else
    echo RAM_ONLY_STATE_CONFIRMED
fi

if test -z "$(losetup -a)"
then
    echo NO_LOOP_REMAINS
else
    echo LOOP_STILL_ATTACHED
fi
